title: Epic Universe Height Requirements: Every Ride Listed
h1: Epic Universe Height Requirements: Every Ride Listed
metaDescription: Every Epic Universe height requirement in one chart — 34 inches on Yoshi's Adventure up to 48 on three coasters — plus the rides with no minimum. Verified September 2026.
summary: The complete Epic Universe height chart: nine rides with minimums, what a 40-inch child can ride, the 48-inch coaster wall, and the thirteen attractions that check nothing at all.
intro: Epic Universe's height chart is a tale of two walls. The first is 40 inches: five of the park's nine height-checked rides sit exactly there, including both of its headliner dark rides. The second is 48 inches, where the three big coasters — Stardust Racers, Dragon Racer's Rally and Monsters Unchained — all begin.

Below 34 inches a child is limited to the park's no-minimum list, and at Epic that list is long: thirteen attractions, including a carousel, two family flat rides, a stage show, a playground and the wand experience, check no height stick at all.
keyPoints: 9 attractions at Epic Universe have a height minimum; 13 have none.
The lowest minimum is 34 inches, on Yoshi's Adventure.
40 inches is the dominant wall: Battle at the Ministry, Mario Kart, Mine-Cart Madness, Hiccup's Wing Gliders and Curse of the Werewolf all sit there.
48 inches is the coaster wall: Stardust Racers, Dragon Racer's Rally and Monsters Unchained.
Every height-checked attraction offers Child Swap, free and with no booking.

sections.heading: The 40-inch wall, and what clears it
body: A child at exactly 40 inches can ride five of the park's nine height-checked attractions: Battle at the Ministry, Mario Kart, Mine-Cart Madness, Hiccup's Wing Gliders and Curse of the Werewolf. That single inch is the most valuable one on the chart — it includes the park's technical centerpiece and its most popular family ride.
Below 40 but at 34, the list is Yoshi's Adventure alone among checked rides. Everything else for a 34-inch child comes from the no-minimum list below.

sections.heading: The 48-inch coaster wall
body: All three of Epic's thrill coasters start at 48 inches: Stardust Racers, the Celestial Park racing coaster; Dragon Racer's Rally on Isle of Berk; and Monsters Unchained: The Frankenstein Experiment in Dark Universe. There is nothing height-checked between 41 and 47 inches — a child at 44 rides exactly what a child at 40 rides.
Child Swap covers all three, so a family with one tall enough and one not can still ride them without anyone sitting out twice.

sections.heading: How Epic's chart compares to the other Universal parks
body: Across the four US Universal parks there are 42 operating attractions with published numerical minimums, from 34 to 54 inches. Epic's own chart is friendlier than it looks: its most common minimum (40) clears both headliner dark rides, and only the three thrill coasters demand 48. The full four-park chart is in our Universal height requirements guide, and the Universal Studios Hollywood chart is here too.

faqs.q: What is the lowest height requirement at Epic Universe?
faqs.a: 34 inches, on Yoshi's Adventure in Super Nintendo World. It is the only attraction at the park with a 34-inch minimum.

faqs.q: Is Harry Potter and the Battle at the Ministry 40 inches?
faqs.a: Yes — Battle at the Ministry requires 40 inches, the same minimum as Mario Kart: Bowser's Challenge, Mine-Cart Madness, Hiccup's Wing Gliders and Curse of the Werewolf.

faqs.q: What is the tallest height requirement at Epic Universe?
faqs.a: 48 inches, shared by the park's three thrill coasters: Stardust Racers, Dragon Racer's Rally and Monsters Unchained: The Frankenstein Experiment. Nothing at the park requires more.

faqs.q: What can a 40-inch child ride at Epic Universe?
faqs.a: Five of the nine height-checked rides — Battle at the Ministry, Mario Kart, Mine-Cart Madness, Hiccup's Wing Gliders and Curse of the Werewolf — plus all thirteen no-minimum attractions. The only checked rides out of reach are the three 48-inch coasters and nothing in between.

faqs.q: Can a child under 34 inches ride anything at Epic Universe?
faqs.a: Yes — thirteen attractions carry no height minimum, including Constellation Carousel, Astronomica, Fyre Drill, Le Cirque Arcanus and the Viking Training Camp playground.
